title: ycmath/cbs-lean: v1.2.0 — nested multichains and the Macaulay-type lower bound
description: Lean 4 formalization for the coffee-bean (CBS) paper series. Release v1.2.0 adds a Macaulay-type lower bound for multichains in nested sets and its consequences: Macaulay representations and operators (MacaulayOps), counting paths by their endpoint (PathCount), the reverse Macaulay inequality h(D+1) ≥ h(D)^⟨D⟩ for nested multichains with its equality case and room bound (NestedChains), the Kruskal–Katona analogue for strict chains (NestedChainsStrict), the sharper complement bound Φ_D (NestedChainsComplement) and its form for chains with any prescribed pattern of strict and weak relations (NestedChainsWords), the lecture-hall form for closed and half-open lattice-point counts (LectureHallMacaulay), and reverse Macaulay growth of coffee-bean label counts with a second proof of coffee-bean maximality and a single-crossing theorem (CbMacaulay). Earlier modules are unchanged. Pinned toolchain: Lean 4.28.0 with Mathlib v4.28.0; zero sorry; #print axioms reports only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
